## Design

### 2026-10-09 – I decided to make a Starbie, I worked with the week one step by step tutorial.

**3h**

I decided to make a Starbie, I worked with the week one step by step tutorial.
I installed Kicad and followed the tutorial.
I made a schematic. At the start I didn't understood everything but after a little research I was able to finish the schematic.

**2.5h**
